comparator_spec_policy.required_canonical_report_phrase: Treat the current comparator-spec report as the canonical dormant GR design handoff report under present dormancy standards.
comparator_spec_policy.required_preparation_not_progress_phrase: It must not be summarized as live GR execution progress, blocker movement, or restart readiness.

non_claim_boundary: Repository-local GR row 001 comparator specification only; no scientific adequacy claim.
